newsitem.title: USA: Torchmark seeks to pull PEPS registration.
newsitem.headline: Torchmark seeks to pull PEPS registration.

text.p: Torchmark Corp said Thursday it requested the withdrawal of its registration statement relating to participating exchangeable premium securities (PEPS).
The securities were to be mandatorily exchangeable at the option of Torchmark into its shares of Vesta Insurance Group Inc.
Torchmark, an insurance company, said the filing was withdrawn because of current market conditions with respect to Vesta common stock.
Vesta stock was trading Thursday at 28-3/8, compared with its 52-week high of 39-3/4.

Depending upon market conditions, Torchmark said it may refile the registration or otherwise provide for the monetization of all or a portion of Vesta common stock held by Torchmark and its subsidiaries.
